arxiv-2012-04879.title: Objective Bayesian approach to the Jeffreys-Lindley paradox
arxiv-2012-04879.creator: Andrew Fowlie addr1 label=e1]andrew.j.fowlie@njnu.edu.cn
arxiv-2012-04879.description: Abstract We consider the Jeffreys-Lindley paradox from an objective Bayesian perspective by attempting to find priors representing complete indifference to sample size in the problem. This means that we ensure that the prior for the unknown mean and the prior predictive for the t t -statistic are independent of the sample size.

arxiv-2203-15248.title: CP 2 Skyrmions and Skyrmion Crystals in Realistic Quantum Magnets
arxiv-2203-15248.creator: Hao Zhang, Zhentao Wang, David Dahlbom, Kipton Barros, Cristian D. Batista
arxiv-2203-15248.description: Abstract Magnetic skyrmions are nanoscale topological textures that have been recently observed in different families of quantum magnets. These textures are known as CP 1 skyrmions because the target manifold of the magnetization field is the 2D sphere S 2 ≅ S^{2}\cong CP 1 .

arxiv-2308-11062.title: UnLoc: A Unified Framework for Video Localization Tasks
arxiv-2308-11062.creator: Shen Yan Xuehan Xiong Arsha Nagrani Anurag Arnab Zhonghao Wang, Weina Ge David Ross Cordelia Schmid
arxiv-2308-11062.description: Abstract While large-scale image-text pretrained models such as CLIP have been used for multiple video-level tasks on trimmed videos, their use for temporal localization in untrimmed videos is still a relatively unexplored task. We design a new approach for this called UnLoc, which uses pretrained image and text towers, and feeds tokens to a video-text fusion model.

arxiv-2401-06640.title: Experimental Contexts Can Facilitate Robust Semantic Property Inference in Language Models, but Inconsistently
arxiv-2401-06640.creator: Kanishka Misra, Allyson Ettinger, Kyle Mahowald
arxiv-2401-06640.description: Abstract Recent zero-shot evaluations have highlighted important limitations in the abilities of language models (LMs) to perform meaning extraction. However, it is now well known that LMs can demonstrate radical improvements in the presence of experimental contexts such as in-context examples and instructions. How well does this translate to previously studied meaning-sensitive tasks?

arxiv-2412-19525.title: Revisiting 3-Sasakian and G 2 G_{2} -structures
arxiv-2412-19525.creator: Simon Salamon and Ragini Singhal
arxiv-2412-19525.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Simon Salamon and Ragini Singhal. The algebra of exterior differential forms on a regular 3-Sasakian 7-manifold is investigated, with special reference to nearly-parallel G 2 G_{2} 3-forms. This is applied to the study of 3-forms invariant under cohomogeneity-one actions by S ​ O ​ ( 4 ) SO(4) on the 7-sphere and on Berger’s space S ​ O ​ ( 5 ) / S ​ O ​ ( 3 ) SO(5)/SO(3) .

arxiv-2501-04694.title: EpiCoder: Encompassing Diversity and Complexity in Code Generation
arxiv-2501-04694.creator: Yaoxiang Wang, Haoling Li, Xin Zhang, Jie Wu, Xiao Liu, Wenxiang Hu, Zhongxin Guo, Yangyu Huang, Ying Xin, Yujiu Yang, Jinsong Su, Qi Chen, Scarlett Li
arxiv-2501-04694.description: Abstract Existing methods for code generation use code snippets as seed data, restricting the complexity and diversity of the synthesized data. In this paper, we introduce a novel feature tree-based synthesis framework, which revolves around hierarchical code features derived from high-level abstractions of code.

arxiv-2503-18060.title: Surrogate Learning in Meta-Black-Box Optimization: A Preliminary Study
arxiv-2503-18060.creator: Zeyuan Ma, Zhiyang Huang, Jiacheng Chen, Zhiguang Cao, Yue-Jiao Gong
arxiv-2503-18060.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Zeyuan Ma, Zhiyang Huang, Jiacheng Chen, Zhiguang Cao, Yue-Jiao Gong. Recent Meta-Black-Box Optimization (MetaBBO) approaches have shown possibility of enhancing the optimization performance through learning meta-level policies to dynamically configure low-level optimizers. However, existing MetaBBO approaches potentially consume massive function evaluations to train their meta-level policies.

arxiv-2504-11635.title: In Pursuit of Total Reproducibility
arxiv-2504-11635.creator: Moritz E. Beber
arxiv-2504-11635.description: Abstract The vast majority of scientific contributions in the field of computational systems biology are based on mathematical models. These models can be broadly classified as either dynamic (kinetic) models or steady-state (constraint-based) models. They are often described in specific markup languages whose purpose is to aid in the distribution and standardization of models.

arxiv-2507-11944.title: Automatic reproducing kernel and regularization for learning convolution kernels
arxiv-2507-11944.creator: Haibo Li, Fei Lu
arxiv-2507-11944.description: Abstract Learning convolution kernels in operators from data arises in numerous applications and represents an ill-posed inverse problem of broad interest. With scant prior information, kernel methods offer a natural nonparametric approach with regularization. However, a major challenge is to select a proper reproducing kernel, especially as operators and data vary.

arxiv-2510-11070.title: Hidden zeros for higher-derivative YM and GR amplitudes at tree-level
arxiv-2510-11070.creator: Kang Zhou
arxiv-2510-11070.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Kang Zhou. We extend the recently discovered phenomenon of hidden zeros to tree amplitudes for Yang-Mills (YM) and general relativity (GR) theories with higher-derivative interactions. This includes gluon amplitudes with a single insertion of the local F 3 F^{3} operator, as well as graviton amplitudes at sub-leading and sub-sub-leading orders in the low-energy expansion of bosonic closed string amplitudes—referred to as R 2 R^{2} and R 3 R^{3} amplitudes, respectively.

arxiv-2511-10762.title: Attentive Feature Aggregation or: How Policies Learn to Stop Worrying about Robustness and Attend to Task-Relevant Visual Cues †
arxiv-2511-10762.creator: Nikolaos Tsagkas, Andreas Sochopoulos, Duolikun Danier, Sethu Vijayakumar, Alexandros Kouris, Oisin Mac Aodha, Chris Xiaoxuan Lu
arxiv-2511-10762.description: Abstract The adoption of pre-trained visual representations (PVRs), leveraging features from large-scale vision models, has become a popular paradigm for training visuomotor policies. However, these powerful representations can encode a broad range of task-irrelevant scene information, making the resulting trained policies vulnerable to out-of-domain visual changes and distractors.

arxiv-2601-15383.title: An Investigation of 5-year Simultaneous X-ray and Radio Light Curves of the Dwarf Seyfert Galaxy UGC 6728 Facilities: Swift-XRT, JVLA XSPEC ( K. A. Arnaud 1996 ) , CASA ( T. C. Team et al. 2022 ) , CARTA ( A. Comrie et al. 2024 )
arxiv-2601-15383.creator: Krista Lynne Smith, Macon Magno, Michael Koss
arxiv-2601-15383.description: Abstract We present serendipitous simultaneous radio and X-ray light curves of the dwarf Seyfert galaxy UGC 6728 spanning 5 years. The X-ray light curve exhibits a flaring period, followed by a gradual rise and decline. Throughout these events, the X-ray hardness ratio and spectrum do not change significantly.

arxiv-2605-10300.creator: Koustav Banerjee, Kathrin Bringmann

arxiv-2606-22676.creator: Dongyub Jude Lee, Jungseob Lee, Seungyoon Lee, Seongtae Hong, Suhyune Son, Sugyeong Eo, Jaehyung Seo, Heuiseok Lim

pmc-10752465.title: The vocal side of empathy: neural correlates of pain perception in spoken complaints
pmc-10752465.creator: Maël Mauchand, Jorge L Armony, Marc D Pell
pmc-10752465.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). In the extensive neuroimaging literature on empathy for pain, few studies have investigated how this phenomenon may relate to everyday social situations such as spoken interactions. The present study used functional Magnetic Resonance Imaging (fMRI) to assess how complaints, as vocal expressions of pain, are empathically processed by listeners and how these empathic responses may vary based on speakers’ vocal expression and cultural identity.

pmc-10773921.title: Transcriptomics yields valuable information regarding the response mechanisms of Chinese Min pigs infected with PEDV
pmc-10773921.creator: Huihui Li, Chunxiang Zhou, Meimei Zhang, Na Yuan, Xiaoyu Huang, Jiaojiao Xiang, Lixian Wang, Lijun Shi
pmc-10773921.description: Porcine epidemic diarrhea virus (PEDV) causes porcine epidemic diarrhea (PED), a highly infectious disease, which has resulted in huge economic losses for the pig industry. To date, the pathogenic and immune response mechanism was not particularly clear. The purpose of this study was to investigate the pathogenic and immune responses of pigs infected with PEDV.

pmc-11437998.title: Impact of theory of planned behavior based intervention on breastfeeding patterns of the mothers with preterm infants: a randomized trial
pmc-11437998.creator: Shirin Okhovat, Mojgan Janighorban, Ashraf Kazemi
pmc-11437998.description: BackgroundThe birth of a preterm infant is considered a crisis for the mother and the family. Given the significance of breastfeeding for these high-risk infants, failure to initiate and maintain exclusive breastfeeding in this group of infants is a prevalent and serious problem.

pmc-11478263.title: Development of Advanced Aluminum and Magnesium Alloys: Microstructure, Mechanical Properties and Processing
pmc-11478263.creator: Wenming Jiang, Qingqing Li
pmc-11478263.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). for large complex light Mg and Al alloys components become higher and higher. Therefore, high-performance advanced Mg and Al light alloys will have great application potentials in the future, which has also become a research hotspot. The development of advanced Mg and Al alloys involves in-depth studies of the microstructures, mechanical properties, and processing techniques of the Mg and Al alloys.

pmc-11672883.title: A Study on the Mechanisms Influencing Older Adults’ Willingness to Use Digital Displays in Museums from a Cognitive Age Perspective
pmc-11672883.creator: Anan Hu, Beiyue Chen, Sai Liu, Jin Zhang, Rosa Silva, Elzbieta Bobrowicz-Campos, Nina Jøranson, Minna Zechner
pmc-11672883.description: As older adults age, changes in their physiological, psychological, and cognitive functions often lead to inherent anxiety and fear regarding the use of digital technologies. Cognitive age, reflecting an older adult’s mental perception of their chronological age, is a crucial moderating factor in shaping their willingness and behavior towards technology adoption.

pmc-12582987.title: Endocrine and regenerative mechanisms of adipose-derived stem cells in female infertility
pmc-12582987.creator: Zaher Merhi, Bhavika Garg, Jessica Haroun
pmc-12582987.description: Infertility remains a global health challenge, particularly in cases involving endometrial damage, diminished ovarian reserve, or poor embryo quality where conventional therapies often fail. Adipose-derived stem cells (ADSCs) have emerged as a promising regenerative option due to their accessibility, multipotency, and paracrine signaling capacity.

pmc-12653935.title: Clinical Severity and Systemic Inflammatory Indices as Predictors of In-Hospital Mortality After Limb Amputation a Retrospective Cohort Study
pmc-12653935.creator: Alim Namitokov, Tarlan Bakhishev, Roman Vinogradov, Aslan Zakeryaev, Sultan Butaev, Eldar Urakov, Gerey Khangereev, Leonid Sakhno, Marina Pchegatluk, Dmitri Ignatenko
pmc-12653935.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Background/Objectives: Major limb amputation is associated with high short-term mortality, yet practical preoperative risk models remain limited. This study aimed to identify easily obtainable preoperative predictors of in-hospital mortality after limb amputation and to develop a compact predictive model. Methods: We retrospectively analyzed 184 adult patients undergoing major or minor limb amputation between January 2021 and July 2025 at a tertiary referral hospital.

pmc-12684773.title: Long‐Term Prognosis and Surgical Outcomes of Culture‐Negative Infective Endocarditis
pmc-12684773.creator: Lanlin Zhang, Sheng Yang, Yuanhang Zhai, Yuheng Dong, Yanxue Zhao, Xinpei Liu, Ruiming Yu, Fupin Guo, Xiaojun Ma, Xiaoxiao Guo, Guotao Ma, Xingrong Liu, Shangdong Xu, Qi Miao, Jun Zheng, Chaoji Zhang
pmc-12684773.description: BackgroundCulture‐negative infective endocarditis (CNIE) presents significant diagnostic and therapeutic challenges due to the absence of identifiable pathogens, leading to empirical antibiotic treatment and potentially worse clinical outcomes. This study aims to compare the clinical characteristics, surgical outcomes, and long‐term prognoses of patients with CNIE and culture‐positive infective endocarditis.

pmc-12771204.title: Herpes simplex virus 2-associated symmetrical peripheral gangrene in an immunocompetent fourteen-year-old girl: a case report
pmc-12771204.creator: Hao Huang, Yu Chen, Yi Yuan, Yi Liao, Xinglou Liu
pmc-12771204.description: BackgroundSymmetrical peripheral gangrene (SPG) is a rare but devastating clinical syndrome marked by symmetrical distal ischemic damage in the absence of large vessel obstruction or vasculitis, usually resulting in high mortality and frequent limb amputations among survivors. The underlying causes are multifactorial, including both infectious and noninfectious factors.

pmc-13234278.title: A retrospective analysis of chronic endometritis and antibiotic therapy in patients with endometriosis
pmc-13234278.creator: Marlene Hager, Johannes Ott, Gerda Hofstetter, Iris Holzer, Katharina Walch, John P. Parry, Julian Marschalek
pmc-13234278.description: Chronic endometritis is linked to recurrent pregnancy loss and in vitro fertilization failure. The responsiveness to antibiotics suggests a bacterial cause, however endometriosis could also play a role. This study aimed to compare treatment responses to antibiotics of patients with and without endometriosis to find out if endometriosis-related immune changes affect treatment success.

pmc-13302373.title: Predictors of first-pass pulmonary vein isolation during very high-power short-duration radiofrequency ablation: a comparison of 90W and 50W protocols
pmc-13302373.creator: D Debreceni, C S Foltanyi, K Janosi, A Ferencz, B Bocz, D Torma, P Kupo
pmc-13302373.description: IntroductionFirst-pass pulmonary vein isolation (FPI) is an important quality marker of atrial fibrillation (AF) ablation, reflecting lesion efficacy and continuity. Very high-power, short-duration(vHPSD) radiofrequency ablation (RFA) has been developed to enhance procedural efficiency while maintaining durable lesion formation. This study aimed to assess the incidence and predictors of left- and right-sided FPI during 90W (vHPSD) and 50W (HPSD) RFA.

pmc-13373386.title: Impact of postoperative chemotherapy in patients resected for esophagogastric adenocarcinoma with major pathological response after preoperative chemotherapy: a study from the FREGAT database
pmc-13373386.creator: Laure Corazzin, Elodie Jeanbert, Olivier Glehen, Caroline Gronnier, Laurent Sulpice, Jean-Marc Gornet, Brice Paquette, Jean-Marc Regimbeau, Cécile Brigand, Xavier-Benoît D’Journo, Pierre-Yves Brichon, Johan Gagnaire, Thibault Voron, Muriel Mathonnet, Christophe Penna, Nicolas Regenet, Côme Lepage, N
pmc-13373386.description: Background:In locally advanced esophagogastric adenocarcinoma (EGA), perioperative chemotherapy is the standard of care and can result in complete/major pathological response. In this setting, real-world data on the impact of postoperative chemotherapy are scarce.Objective:The primary objective was to assess the impact of postoperative chemotherapy on overall survival (OS) in cases of complete/major pathological response and/or no serosal involvement.

pmc-13637107.title: Type 2 diabetes risk and health-promoting behaviours among health sciences students: a cross-sectional analysis using FINDRISC and HPLP-II
pmc-13637107.creator: Esma Aksoy Kendilci, Kenan Kendilci, Fatma Söylemez, Rumeysa Deniz, Dilan Akyol
pmc-13637107.description: BackgroundThe global burden of type 2 diabetes mellitus has continued to increase, and early signs of behavioural risk are now being detected even in young adults. Understanding these risks in student populations is important for the development of early prevention strategies.

pmc-13719157.title: From Dysfunction to Differentiation: A New Paradigm of T Cell Exhaustion
pmc-13719157.creator: V. M. Stepanova, A. S. Logvinov, E. A. Emelyanov, N. A. Katin, Yu. P. Rubtsov
pmc-13719157.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). CD8+ T cell exhaustion is the loss of certain functions typical of cytotoxic lymphocytes. CD8+ cytotoxic T cells originate from naive CD8+ T cells upon antigen exposure. Chronic or excessive antigen exposure during certain infections and cancers triggers inhibitory mechanisms that lead to functional exhaustion - a loss of the ability to secrete IFN-γ and other cytokines, as well as to produce granzyme- and perforin-containing lytic granules in response to stimulation.
